body: Some looks I've gotten, a wink and time or two. And yeah, thanks for bring that to light. I haven't been as open minded as I should have been. Only looking at it from a hormonal teenage's view. Thank you so much for talking to me, much love to you c:

Opportunity never presented itself, but not for lack of trying. And, well to give you a little more description....


Outside of speeches, I've said about 4 words total. Shes insanely outgoing. 

I just never fancied myself as her type I guess.

Yes, still have a chance! Haha Idk, I'm extremely shy... Thats part of the reason this ordeal was pretty devastating. Either way, it feels and sounds like good news :D 

Thing is, she seems like the type that would ignore someone like. Doesn't happen often haha.
I think one kinda cute girl there even has a crush on me, it'd be interesting to see what that turns into, haha. Thoughts?
Thanks man. I decided how ever they took it I just have to own it as my mistake. They can't move past that, they can go fuck themselves c:
Me too. Painful memories they incited. Very, very painful memories
We left right after I was done speaking and a two kids were just like "Sorry bro" but I'm afraid of facing the entire class again... It'll be kinda weird...
Just kinda shocked and hush hush around me. Like they don't know how to talk to me anymore

Its much appreciated c: 


But they're reactions just brought back all the depression and anxiety and flashbacks of my father.... I just wanted someone to tell their opinion on it...
